blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解 ICH Q12 如何作為 PAC 法規彈性的核心框架，以及目前全球協調工作的進展與缺口。
blocks.en: Understand how ICH Q12 serves as the core framework for regulatory flexibility in PACs, and the current progress and gaps in global harmonization efforts.

blocks.zh: 掌握有效 PQS（製藥品質系統）的五大關鍵要素，說明每個要素如何支撐 PAC 管理。
blocks.en: Grasp the five key elements of an effective PQS (Pharmaceutical Quality System) and explain how each supports PAC management.

blocks.zh: 理解高階管理層（Management Review）在 PAC 文化建立中的責任，超越單純法規遵循的思維。
blocks.en: Understand the responsibility of senior management (Management Review) in building a PAC culture, going beyond a mindset of mere regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: 辨別 CAPA 系統如何成為 PAC 流程的起點，以及變更管理系統如何決定法規申報路徑。
blocks.en: Recognize how the CAPA system becomes the starting point of the PAC process, and how the change management system determines the regulatory reporting pathway.

blocks.zh: 解釋 QRM（品質風險管理）與 KM（知識管理）如何共同使 PAC 決策更科學、更具彈性。
blocks.en: Explain how QRM (Quality Risk Management) and KM (Knowledge Management) together make PAC decisions more science-based and more flexible.

blocks.zh: 3.0 Background and Landscape for PACs — 背景與全球監管環境
blocks.en: 3.0 Background and Landscape for PACs

blocks.zh: 解說：全球 PAC 監管環境
blocks.en: Commentary: The Global PAC Regulatory Landscape

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼需要協調？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Harmonization Needed?

blocks.zh: 藥廠做一個變更（例如更換原料藥來源），在美國可能只需 CBE-30（30天通知），在歐盟卻需要 Type II（重大變更，事前核准），在日本又是另一套規定。同樣的風險，四套報告要求 — 這就是 PAC 全球複雜性的核心問題。
blocks.en: When a manufacturer makes a change (for example, changing the drug substance source), the US may require only a CBE-30 (30-day notification), the EU may require a Type II variation (a major change requiring prior approval), and Japan has yet another set of rules. The same risk leads to four different reporting requirements, and this is the core problem of global PAC complexity.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12（2019年發布）是迄今最重要的框架，試圖把這些分歧拉近。但 Q12 只是起點，非終點。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 (published in 2019) is the most important framework to date and tries to bring these divergent approaches closer together. But Q12 is only a starting point, not the end point.

blocks.zh: 比喻：護照通關 vs. 每國重辦簽證
blocks.en: Analogy: Passport Clearance vs Reapplying for a Visa in Every Country

blocks.zh: 試想你持有一本護照，在大多數國家可以快速通關，但每次都要重新辦理該國簽證 — 即使你的風險評估已做得很完整。現在的 PAC 世界就是這樣：每個市場都要「重新申報」，不承認其他地區的評估結果。
blocks.en: Imagine you hold a passport that gets you through border control quickly in most countries, yet you must apply for that country's visa afresh every time, even though your risk assessment has been thoroughly completed. The PAC world today is just like this: every market requires you to "re-file" and does not recognize the assessment results from other regions.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的願景就是讓「品質護照」成立：如果你的 PQS 夠強、資料夠透明，主管機關應該信任你、讓你用更低的申報類別管理低風險變更。
blocks.en: The vision of ICH Q12 is to make a "quality passport" work: if your PQS is strong enough and your data transparent enough, regulators should trust you and let you manage low-risk changes under a lower reporting category.

blocks.zh: 重點：三層申報架構
blocks.en: Key Point: The Three-Tier Reporting Structure

blocks.zh: 高風險 → 事前核准（Prior Approval / PAS / Type II）：先說、等待、再做
blocks.en: High risk → Prior approval (Prior Approval / PAS / Type II): tell the authority, wait, then act

blocks.zh: 中低風險 → 通知（Notification / CBE / Type IB）：做了之後告知
blocks.en: Moderate to low risk → Notification (Notification / CBE / Type IB): act first, then inform

blocks.zh: 低風險 → 完全由 PQS 管理：只在內部記錄，無需外部申報
blocks.en: Low risk → Managed entirely within the PQS: recorded internally only, with no external reporting

blocks.zh: 這個三層架構是 TR91 整份報告的底層邏輯 — 每個後續章節都在探討「如何讓更多變更往低風險那一層移動」。
blocks.en: This three-tier structure is the underlying logic of the whole of TR91. Every subsequent section explores "how to move more changes toward the lower-risk tier".

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise

blocks.zh: 你們公司上一次做 PAC（例如更換供應商、調整灌裝速度），在美國、歐盟、台灣各做了哪種申報？申報準備時間有多大差異？
blocks.en: The last time your company made a PAC (for example, changing a supplier or adjusting the filling speed), what type of filing was made in the US, the EU and Taiwan? How much did the filing preparation time differ?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 PQS 已達到 ICH Q10 的成熟水準，理論上你有資格爭取哪些變更的「降級申報」？這個問題值得帶入下次管理層審查討論。
blocks.en: If your PQS has reached the maturity level of ICH Q10, which changes would you theoretically be eligible to "downgrade" to a lower reporting category? This question is worth bringing to the next management review discussion.

blocks.zh: 各地區申報類別對照（同一變更，不同要求）
blocks.en: Reporting Categories by Region (Same Change, Different Requirements)

blocks.zh: 同一個製程變更，在不同地區可能落在不同類別 — 這正是全球協調工作的難點。
blocks.en: The same process change may fall into different categories in different regions, and this is exactly what makes global harmonization difficult.

blocks.zh: 4.0 Key Elements of a Pharmaceutical Quality System for PAC Management — PQS 五大核心要素
blocks.en: 4.0 Key Elements of a Pharmaceutical Quality System for PAC Management

blocks.zh: 解說：PQS 是 PAC 的地基
blocks.en: Commentary: The PQS Is the Foundation of PAC

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PQS 不只是文件系統
blocks.en: Core Concept: The PQS Is More Than a Document System

blocks.zh: PQS（製藥品質系統）在這裡的意義遠超過 SOP 和記錄管理。它是一套能夠「主動識別變更需求、評估風險、決定申報類別、執行變更、驗證效果」的完整管理架構。
blocks.en: The PQS (Pharmaceutical Quality System) here means far more than SOPs and record management. It is a complete management framework that can "proactively identify the need for change, assess risk, determine the reporting category, implement the change and verify its effect".

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 的核心主張：一家公司的 PQS 越成熟，主管機關就越願意讓它自主管理低風險變更 — 減少事前核准、增加 PQS 內部自理。這是「信任換取彈性」的交換邏輯。
blocks.en: The core proposition of ICH Q12 is this: the more mature a company's PQS, the more willing regulators are to let it manage low-risk changes on its own, with less prior approval and more self-management within the PQS. This is an exchange logic of "trust in return for flexibility".

blocks.zh: 比喻：飛行員執照分級
blocks.en: Analogy: Pilot License Grades

blocks.zh: 初學飛行員每次起飛都需要塔台核准；有儀器飛行證書（IFR）的飛行員可以在更多條件下自主判斷；有豐富記錄的機長甚至可以在特定情境下自主決策。
blocks.en: A novice pilot needs tower clearance for every takeoff; a pilot with an instrument rating (IFR) can make independent decisions under more conditions; a captain with an extensive record can even make autonomous decisions in certain situations.

blocks.zh: PQS 就是你的「飛行紀錄本」——越完整、越成熟，主管機關對你的信任度越高，賦予你的自主空間也越大。
blocks.en: Your PQS is your "flight logbook": the more complete and mature it is, the more the regulator trusts you and the more room for autonomy it gives you.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的特別責任
blocks.en: Special Responsibilities of the CDMO

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO（例如 TWi），你的客戶是 MAH（上市許可持有人），但製程發生在你的設施裡。這段話特別重要：
blocks.en: If you are a CDMO (for example, TWi), your client is the MAH (Marketing Authorization Holder), but the process takes place in your facility. This passage is especially important:

blocks.zh: CDMO 必須維持有效 PQS，且與客戶的 PAC 責任合約有明確規範
blocks.en: The CDMO must maintain an effective PQS, with PAC responsibilities clearly specified in the contract with the client

blocks.zh: 變更管理的生命週期責任（包括申報）不因外包而消失
blocks.en: Lifecycle responsibility for change management (including regulatory filing) does not disappear because of outsourcing

blocks.zh: 客戶的申報義務 + CDMO 的 PQS 能力，兩者缺一不可
blocks.en: The client's filing obligations and the CDMO's PQS capability are both indispensable

blocks.zh: 你們的 CDMO 合約中，對 PAC 的責任歸屬是否有明確條款？當製程在你們廠發生變更時，誰啟動 PAC 評估？誰決定申報類別？這個流程是否書面化？
blocks.en: Does your CDMO contract include clear clauses on the allocation of PAC responsibilities? When a process change takes place at your site, who initiates the PAC assessment? Who decides the reporting category? Is this process documented in writing?

blocks.zh: 4.1 Management Review — 管理層審查
blocks.en: 4.1 Management Review

blocks.zh: 解說：管理層是 PAC 的守門人
blocks.en: Commentary: Management Is the Gatekeeper of PAC

blocks.zh: 核心概念：PAC 是品質系統活動，不只是法規合規
blocks.en: Core Concept: PAC Is a Quality System Activity, Not Just Regulatory Compliance

blocks.zh: 許多公司把 PAC 視為「法規部門的事」——只有在必須申報時才啟動。但 ICH Q10 的精神是：PAC 應該是管理層定期審查的議題，因為每一個變更都是產品生命週期管理的一部分。
blocks.en: Many companies regard PAC as "the regulatory department's job", triggered only when a filing is required. But the spirit of ICH Q10 is that PAC should be a topic for periodic management review, because every change is part of product lifecycle management.

blocks.zh: 管理層的責任具體包括：定義角色、分配資源、建立文化。特別是「文化」這一點，不是管理層說說而已 — 員工看到的日常行為才算數。
blocks.en: Management's responsibilities specifically include defining roles, allocating resources and building a culture. The "culture" point in particular is not about management merely saying the right things: what employees see in daily behavior is what counts.

blocks.zh: 比喻：品質文化如同組織免疫系統
blocks.en: Analogy: Quality Culture Is Like the Organization's Immune System

blocks.zh: 免疫系統不是在你生病時才啟動的 — 它平時就在運作，隨時識別異常並回應。品質文化也是如此：不是在稽查前緊急補文件，而是每個人在日常工作中都把「這個決定對病患安全有何影響？」當成反射性問題。
blocks.en: The immune system does not activate only when you are ill. It is working all the time, constantly recognizing abnormalities and responding to them. Quality culture is the same: it is not a scramble to fix documents before an inspection, but a situation where everyone reflexively asks in daily work, "What impact does this decision have on patient safety?"

blocks.zh: 管理層的角色是讓這個「免疫系統」保持活化 — 通過榜樣、資源、教育訓練，而不只是 KPI 考核。
blocks.en: The role of management is to keep this "immune system" active, through role modeling, resources and training, and not just KPI assessments.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：管理審查與 PAC 的連結
blocks.en: Key Point: Linking Management Review and PAC

blocks.zh: 你的年度管理審查（Management Review）是否包含以下 PAC 相關指標？
blocks.en: Does your annual Management Review include the following PAC-related indicators?

blocks.zh: 本年度啟動的 PAC 數量與類型
blocks.en: Number and types of PACs initiated this year

blocks.zh: PAC 申報時間是否符合各市場要求
blocks.en: Whether PAC filing times meet the requirements of each market

blocks.zh: PAC 有效性查核（Effectiveness Check）的結果
blocks.en: Results of PAC effectiveness checks

blocks.zh: 因 PAC 衍生的 CAPA 追蹤狀況
blocks.en: Status of tracking for CAPAs arising from PACs

blocks.zh: 如果這些指標不在管理審查中，PAC 就只是法規部門的例行工作，而非公司層級的品質承諾。
blocks.en: If these indicators are not in the management review, PAC is only routine work of the regulatory department, rather than a company-level quality commitment.

blocks.zh: 上次你參加或主持管理審查時，有沒有討論到「我們的 PAC 管理有沒有比上一年度更有效率？」這個問題？如果沒有，是什麼原因？資料不足、沒有指定負責人，還是組織文化上這不被視為管理層該關心的事？
blocks.en: At the last management review you attended or chaired, did you discuss the question "Is our PAC management more efficient than last year?" If not, why not? Insufficient data, no designated owner, or an organizational culture in which this is not seen as something management should care about?

blocks.zh: 4.2 Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Program — CAPA 系統
blocks.en: 4.2 Corrective Action and Preventive Action (CAPA) Program

blocks.zh: 解說：CAPA 是 PAC 的起點
blocks.en: Commentary: CAPA Is the Starting Point of PAC

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CAPA → 變更需求 → PAC
blocks.en: Core Concept: CAPA → Need for Change → PAC

blocks.zh: CAPA 系統是 PAC 流程最常見的發源地。以下是典型的觸發路徑：
blocks.en: The CAPA system is the most common origin of the PAC process. Typical trigger paths are as follows:

blocks.zh: 缺陷矯正：OOS（超標結果）調查 → 根本原因是製程不穩定 → CAPA 要求製程改善 → 觸發 PAC
blocks.en: Defect correction: OOS (out-of-specification) investigation → root cause is an unstable process → CAPA requires process improvement → triggers a PAC

blocks.zh: 主動改善：趨勢分析發現製程漂移 → 預防性 CAPA → 啟動製程優化 PAC
blocks.en: Proactive improvement: trend analysis detects process drift → preventive CAPA → triggers a process optimization PAC

blocks.zh: 法規更新：主管機關發布新指引 → 現有方法不符合 → CAPA 要求方法驗證更新 → PAC
blocks.en: Regulatory update: the authority issues new guidance → the existing method is non-compliant → CAPA requires an update of method validation → PAC

blocks.zh: CAPA 不只是「出了問題才做」，理想狀態下大多數行動應該是「預防性」的 — 這正是成熟 PQS 的標誌。
blocks.en: CAPA is not just "done when something goes wrong". Ideally, most actions should be "preventive", which is the hallmark of a mature PQS.

blocks.zh: 比喻：CAPA 是品質系統的神經系統
blocks.en: Analogy: CAPA Is the Nervous System of the Quality System

blocks.zh: 神經系統接收全身訊號（痛覺、壓力、溫度），整合後輸出指令（縮手、調整姿勢）。CAPA 系統的功能類似：接收各種品質訊號（偏差、投訴、稽查觀察），整合根本原因分析，輸出系統性改善行動。
blocks.en: The nervous system receives signals from the whole body (pain, pressure, temperature), integrates them and outputs commands (withdrawing a hand, adjusting posture). The CAPA system functions similarly: it receives various quality signals (deviations, complaints, inspection observations), integrates root cause analysis and outputs systemic improvement actions.

blocks.zh: 一個「只有反應，沒有預防」的 CAPA 系統，就像一個只有痛覺、沒有本體感覺的神經系統 — 等到痛了才知道出問題，已經太晚了。
blocks.en: A CAPA system with "reaction but no prevention" is like a nervous system with only pain sensation and no proprioception: by the time it hurts, you find out something is wrong too late.

blocks.zh: 重點：CAPA 與 PAC 的雙向關係
blocks.en: Key Point: The Two-Way Relationship Between CAPA and PAC

blocks.zh: CAPA 不只觸發 PAC，也必須監控 PAC 本身帶來的非預期後果。一個變更實施後，如果監測發現品質指標惡化，必須立即啟動 CAPA — 這是 PAC 有效性查核的安全閥機制。
blocks.en: CAPA not only triggers PAC but must also monitor the unintended consequences brought by the PAC itself. If monitoring after a change is implemented shows quality indicators deteriorating, a CAPA must be initiated immediately. This is the safety valve mechanism of the PAC effectiveness check.

blocks.zh: 雙向流動：CAPA → PAC，以及 PAC 後監測 → CAPA。
blocks.en: Two-way flow: CAPA → PAC, and post-PAC monitoring → CAPA.

blocks.zh: 回顧你們過去12個月的 CAPA 清單：有多少 CAPA 最終觸發了 PAC 評估？這個比例是否合理？如果 CAPA 很多但 PAC 幾乎沒有，可能代表 CAPA 處理的都是表面問題，沒有觸及製程根本改善。
blocks.en: Review your CAPA list for the past 12 months: how many CAPAs ultimately triggered a PAC assessment? Is that proportion reasonable? If there are many CAPAs but almost no PACs, it may mean the CAPAs are dealing only with surface problems and not reaching fundamental process improvement.

blocks.zh: 4.3 Change Management System — 變更管理系統
blocks.en: 4.3 Change Management System

blocks.zh: 解說：變更管理系統決定申報路徑
blocks.en: Commentary: The Change Management System Determines the Reporting Pathway

blocks.zh: 核心概念：變更分類決定一切
blocks.en: Core Concept: Change Classification Determines Everything

blocks.zh: 變更管理系統的最關鍵功能是「分類」——這個變更是否影響 CQA？是否涉及 CPP？是否改變了 Established Conditions（EC）？這些問題的答案直接決定申報類別。
blocks.en: The most critical function of the change management system is "classification": does this change affect a CQA? Does it involve a CPP? Does it alter Established Conditions (ECs)? The answers to these questions directly determine the reporting category.

blocks.zh: 典型的變更管理流程：
blocks.en: A typical change management process:

blocks.zh: 變更提案（Change Initiation）
blocks.en: Change Initiation

blocks.zh: 影響評估（Impact Assessment：CQA / CPP / EC）
blocks.en: Impact Assessment (CQA / CPP / EC)

blocks.zh: 法規分類（Regulatory Classification）
blocks.en: Regulatory Classification

blocks.zh: 實施 → 驗證 → 有效性查核
blocks.en: Implementation → Validation → Effectiveness Check

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築許可申請
blocks.en: Analogy: Applying for a Building Permit

blocks.zh: 你要改建房子：換一扇窗（低風險）vs. 拆掉一面承重牆（高風險）。換窗只需內部記錄；拆牆需要建築師評估、結構工程師簽名、政府核可。
blocks.en: You want to renovate your house: replacing a window (low risk) vs knocking down a load-bearing wall (high risk). Replacing a window needs only an internal record; knocking down a wall requires an architect's assessment, a structural engineer's signature and government approval.

blocks.zh: 變更管理系統就是那個「判斷這個改動是換窗還是拆牆」的評估機制。問題在於：很多公司沒有清晰的判斷標準，導致所有變更都按最高等級申報（浪費資源），或者低估風險少報（監管風險）。
blocks.en: The change management system is the assessment mechanism that decides "is this change a window replacement or a wall demolition?" The problem is that many companies lack clear criteria for this, so either all changes are filed at the highest level (wasting resources) or risk is underestimated and changes are under-reported (regulatory risk).

blocks.zh: 重點：Established Conditions (ECs) 的核心地位
blocks.en: Key Point: The Central Position of Established Conditions (ECs)

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 引入 EC（已建立條件）的概念：這些是法規申請中記載的製程/產品參數，一旦改變就需要申報。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 introduced the concept of ECs (Established Conditions): these are the process/product parameters described in the regulatory submission, and any change to them requires a filing.

blocks.zh: 有效的變更管理系統必須能清楚回答：「這個變更是否改變了任何 EC？」如果 EC 清單設計得好（只包含真正關鍵的參數），公司就能把更多低風險變更保留在 PQS 內部管理。
blocks.en: An effective change management system must be able to answer clearly: "Does this change alter any EC?" If the EC list is well designed (containing only truly critical parameters), the company can keep more low-risk changes managed within the PQS.

blocks.zh: 你們公司的 CMS（Change Management System）在評估一個新的變更時，是否有結構化的問卷或決策樹來判斷是否影響 CQA/CPP/EC？這個判斷是由誰做出的（單人決定 vs. 跨部門審查）？文件記錄是否足以支撐未來稽查時的科學論證？
blocks.en: When your CMS (Change Management System) assesses a new change, is there a structured questionnaire or decision tree for determining whether it affects CQAs/CPPs/ECs? Who makes this determination (a single decision-maker vs cross-functional review)? Is the documentation sufficient to support the scientific justification in a future inspection?

blocks.zh: 4.4 Process Performance and Product Quality Monitoring — 製程績效與產品品質監測
blocks.en: 4.4 Process Performance and Product Quality Monitoring

blocks.zh: 解說：APR/PQR 是 PAC 觸發器
blocks.en: Commentary: APR/PQR Is a PAC Trigger

blocks.zh: 核心概念：監測數據 = PAC 的科學依據
blocks.en: Core Concept: Monitoring Data = The Scientific Basis for PAC

blocks.zh: PPPQ（製程績效與產品品質）監測，也就是我們日常說的 APR（Annual Product Review）或 PQR（Product Quality Review），是 PAC 的兩個關鍵功能：
blocks.en: PPPQ (process performance and product quality) monitoring, which in daily practice we call the APR (Annual Product Review) or PQR (Product Quality Review), has two key functions in PAC:

blocks.zh: 觸發功能：趨勢分析發現 OOS 增加、穩定性失敗、製程漂移 → 產生變更需求 → 觸發 PAC
blocks.en: Trigger function: trend analysis detects increasing OOS results, stability failures or process drift → generates a need for change → triggers a PAC

blocks.zh: 驗證功能：變更實施後，監測數據確認變更沒有帶來非預期後果
blocks.en: Verification function: after a change is implemented, monitoring data confirm that the change has not brought unintended consequences

blocks.zh: 沒有完善監測計畫的公司，等於既無法提前發現問題，也無法在申報時提交有力的數據支持。
blocks.en: A company without a sound monitoring plan can neither detect problems early nor submit strong supporting data at the time of filing.

blocks.zh: 比喻：心電圖 vs. 只在胸痛時才量血壓
blocks.en: Analogy: Continuous ECG vs Taking Blood Pressure Only When You Have Chest Pain

blocks.zh: 連續心電圖監測可以在心臟病發前就發現異常心律；只有在胸痛時才去量血壓，等到症狀出現時往往已經是嚴重問題。
blocks.en: Continuous ECG monitoring can detect an abnormal heart rhythm before a heart attack; if you measure blood pressure only when you have chest pain, by the time symptoms appear the problem is often already serious.

blocks.zh: 製程監測就是品質系統的「連續心電圖」——越早發現趨勢偏離，越能以低成本的預防性 PAC 介入，而不是等到批次失敗才做緊急矯正。
blocks.en: Process monitoring is the "continuous ECG" of the quality system: the earlier a trend deviation is detected, the more a low-cost preventive PAC can intervene, instead of waiting for a batch failure and then taking emergency corrective action.

blocks.zh: 重點：變更前後的監測密度
blocks.en: Key Point: Monitoring Intensity Before and After a Change

blocks.zh: 這段文字有一個非常實用的操作指引：變更實施後，監測頻率應該提高（increased monitoring frequency），直到確認製程仍在預期範圍內。
blocks.en: This passage contains a very practical operating guideline: after a change is implemented, monitoring frequency should be increased (increased monitoring frequency) until it is confirmed that the process remains within the expected range.

blocks.zh: 在驗證方案（Validation Protocol）和 PAC 申報文件中，應該明確說明：
blocks.en: The Validation Protocol and the PAC filing documents should state clearly:

blocks.zh: 變更前基線數據（Pre-change baseline）
blocks.en: Pre-change baseline data (Pre-change baseline)

blocks.zh: 變更後強化監測計畫（Post-change enhanced monitoring plan）
blocks.en: Post-change enhanced monitoring plan (Post-change enhanced monitoring plan)

blocks.zh: 回復正常監測的判斷標準（Criteria to return to normal monitoring）
blocks.en: Criteria to return to normal monitoring (Criteria to return to normal monitoring)

blocks.zh: 你們的 APR/PQR 報告有沒有「PAC 觸發分析」這一節？也就是：本年度 APR 發現了哪些趨勢，哪些趨勢已轉化為正式的變更評估？如果 APR 只是例行性的數據彙整，沒有連接到變更管理系統，它對 PAC 的價值就大打折扣。
blocks.en: Does your APR/PQR report have a section on "PAC trigger analysis"? That is: which trends did this year's APR identify, and which of them have been converted into formal change assessments? If the APR is only a routine compilation of data and is not connected to the change management system, its value for PAC is greatly diminished.

blocks.zh: 4.5 Quality Risk Management and Knowledge Management — QRM 與知識管理
blocks.en: 4.5 Quality Risk Management and Knowledge Management

blocks.zh: 解說：QRM + KM 是 PAC 決策的雙引擎
blocks.en: Commentary: QRM + KM Are the Twin Engines of PAC Decisions

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QRM 決定「做不做」，KM 決定「怎麼證明」
blocks.en: Core Concept: QRM Decides "Whether to Do It", KM Decides "How to Prove It"

blocks.zh: QRM（ICH Q9） 在 PAC 中的作用：
blocks.en: The role of QRM (ICH Q9) in PAC:

blocks.zh: 用 FMEA、風險矩陣等工具評估變更的潛在影響
blocks.en: Use tools such as FMEA and risk matrices to assess the potential impact of a change

blocks.zh: 決定這個變更是「高風險需要事前核准」還是「低風險可以 PQS 自管」
blocks.en: Decide whether the change is "high risk, requiring prior approval" or "low risk, manageable within the PQS"

blocks.zh: 讓申報決策有可追溯的科學依據
blocks.en: Give the filing decision a traceable scientific basis

blocks.zh: KM（ICH Q10） 在 PAC 中的作用：
blocks.en: The role of KM (ICH Q10) in PAC:

blocks.zh: 彙整歷史製程知識、先前驗證數據、研發階段的理解
blocks.en: Consolidate historical process knowledge, prior validation data and understanding from the development stage

blocks.zh: 讓風險評估不是憑感覺，而是基於「我們真的了解這個製程」
blocks.en: Make risk assessment based not on gut feeling but on "we truly understand this process"

blocks.zh: 當知識充分時，可以支持更低的申報類別（因為「我們了解，所以風險可控」）
blocks.en: When knowledge is sufficient, it can support a lower reporting category (because "we understand it, so the risk is controlled")

blocks.zh: 比喻：QRM 是 GPS 導航，KM 是地圖資料庫
blocks.en: Analogy: QRM Is GPS Navigation, KM Is the Map Database

blocks.zh: GPS（QRM）告訴你現在應該走哪條路、風險在哪裡；但如果地圖資料庫（KM）是空的或過時的，GPS 再強也會導錯路。
blocks.en: The GPS (QRM) tells you which road to take now and where the risks are; but if the map database (KM) is empty or outdated, even the best GPS will route you wrongly.

blocks.zh: 同樣地，QRM 工具再精良，如果公司沒有完整保存製程知識（驗證報告、DOE 數據、歷史趨勢），風險評估就只是紙上談兵。KM 是 QRM 的燃料。
blocks.en: Likewise, however sophisticated the QRM tools, if the company has not fully retained its process knowledge (validation reports, DOE data, historical trends), the risk assessment is merely theoretical. KM is the fuel of QRM.

blocks.zh: 重點：知識充分 = 申報類別降低
blocks.en: Key Point: Sufficient Knowledge = A Lower Reporting Category

blocks.zh: 這是本節最重要的實務啟示：FDA、Health Canada、WHO 的指引都明確表示，當一個變更被充分論證為「對產品影響極小」時，可以降低申報類別（甚至只需年度申報）。
blocks.en: This is the most important practical takeaway of this section: the guidance of FDA, Health Canada and WHO all state explicitly that when a change is adequately justified as having "minimal impact on the product", the reporting category can be lowered (even to annual reporting only).

blocks.zh: 這個「充分論證」就需要 KM + QRM 共同支撐：
blocks.en: This "adequate justification" requires KM and QRM to work together:

blocks.zh: KM 提供：我們了解這個製程對產品品質的影響機理
blocks.en: KM provides: we understand the mechanism by which this process affects product quality

blocks.zh: QRM 提供：風險評估顯示這個變更不會影響 CQA
blocks.en: QRM provides: the risk assessment shows that this change will not affect CQAs

blocks.zh: 結論：申報類別可以從 PAS 降為 CBE-30 或 Annual Report
blocks.en: Conclusion: the reporting category can be downgraded from PAS to CBE-30 or Annual Report

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這也意味著：越早建立完整的製程知識庫，越能在未來的 PAC 中幫助客戶節省申報時間和成本。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this also means that the earlier you build a complete process knowledge base, the more you can help clients save filing time and cost in future PACs.

blocks.zh: 你們的製程知識目前存放在哪裡？是分散在各個驗證報告、研發筆記、個別部門的 Excel 裡，還是有一個可搜尋、可引用的結構化知識庫？當你需要做一個 PAC 的風險評估時，能多快找到支持性的歷史數據？
blocks.en: Where is your process knowledge currently stored? Is it scattered across validation reports, development notebooks and individual departments' Excel files, or is there a searchable, citable, structured knowledge base? When you need to perform a risk assessment for a PAC, how quickly can you find supporting historical data?

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO，你的製程知識庫是否已足夠支持未來客戶要求的「降級申報論證」？這是一個值得現在就開始投資的能力。
blocks.en: If you are a CDMO, is your process knowledge base already sufficient to support the "downgrade justification" that clients may require in the future? This is a capability worth starting to invest in now.

blocks.zh: Section 2 重點總結 — PQS 五要素與全球 PAC 框架
blocks.en: Section 2 Key Takeaways: The Five PQS Elements and the Global PAC Framework

blocks.zh: 核心架構回顧
blocks.en: Review of the Core Framework

blocks.zh: ICH Q12（2019） 是 PAC 監管彈性的使能框架，但全球協調仍有缺口（分類標準、申報時程、非 ICH 地區）。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 (2019) is the enabling framework for regulatory flexibility in PACs, but gaps in global harmonization remain (classification criteria, filing timelines, non-ICH regions).

blocks.zh: 三層申報架構：高風險（事前核准）→ 中低風險（通知）→ 低風險（PQS 自管）— 目標是讓更多變更落在後兩層。
blocks.en: Three-tier reporting structure: high risk (prior approval) → moderate to low risk (notification) → low risk (managed within the PQS). The goal is to have more changes fall into the latter two tiers.

blocks.zh: 強大的 PQS 是獲得監管信任的關鍵，是讓更多 PAC 在公司內部管理的前提。
blocks.en: A strong PQS is the key to earning regulatory trust and the precondition for managing more PACs inside the company.

blocks.zh: CDMO 有特別責任：須與客戶合約明定 PAC 責任歸屬，且自身 PQS 必須有效。
blocks.en: The CDMO has special responsibilities: PAC responsibilities must be defined in the client contract, and its own PQS must be effective.

blocks.zh: PQS 五要素與其 PAC 功能
blocks.en: The Five PQS Elements and Their PAC Functions

blocks.zh: 管理審查（4.1）：定義責任、投入資源、建立品質文化 — PAC 是公司層級的品質承諾，不只是法規部門的事。
blocks.en: Management Review (4.1): defines responsibilities, commits resources and builds quality culture. PAC is a company-level quality commitment, not just the regulatory department's business.

blocks.zh: CAPA（4.2）：PAC 最常見的起點；也是變更後非預期後果的偵測機制。CAPA → 變更請求 → PAC。
blocks.en: CAPA (4.2): the most common starting point of PAC, and also the mechanism for detecting unintended consequences after a change. CAPA → change request → PAC.

blocks.zh: 變更管理系統（4.3）：評估 CQA/CPP/EC 影響、決定申報類別 — 分類準確是降低申報負擔的關鍵。
blocks.en: Change Management System (4.3): assesses the impact on CQA/CPP/EC and determines the reporting category. Accurate classification is the key to reducing filing burden.

blocks.zh: PPPQ 監測（4.4）：APR/PQR 是 PAC 觸發器；變更前後的監測數據是科學論證的基礎。
blocks.en: PPPQ Monitoring (4.4): APR/PQR is a PAC trigger; monitoring data before and after a change are the basis of the scientific justification.

blocks.zh: QRM + KM（4.5）：QRM 評估風險、KM 提供製程知識 — 兩者充分則可支持申報類別降級。
blocks.en: QRM + KM (4.5): QRM assesses risk and KM provides process knowledge. When both are sufficient, they can support a downgrade of the reporting category.

blocks.zh: 給 CDMO 運營主管的一句話： TR91 Section 2 的核心訊息是：PAC 監管彈性不是「爭取」來的，而是「證明」出來的 — 用你的 PQS 成熟度、監測數據品質、風險評估嚴謹度，換取主管機關對你的信任。建立這五個要素，不只是為了合規，而是為了讓未來的每一個變更都能更快、更低成本地實施。
blocks.en: One sentence for CDMO operations leaders: The core message of TR91 Section 2 is that PAC regulatory flexibility is not "won" but "demonstrated": you earn the regulator's trust through the maturity of your PQS, the quality of your monitoring data and the rigor of your risk assessments. Building these five elements is not just for compliance, but so that every future change can be implemented faster and at lower cost.
